description.value: The Woods is a restaurant located within Big White Ski Resort, one of BC's largest ski destinations situated in the Okanagan highlands east of Kelowna. It operates as part of the resort's dining lineup in a mountain village setting. Big White is a four-season resort, and visiting cyclists may find it on route to or from the resort during summer operations.
